desc.coastalHazards: Coastal erosion rate, metres per year (Digital Earth Africa, 2000–2022), by district. Scores 0 for every unit in this workbook.
desc.drought: Historic drought frequency, years (FAO, 1984–2023), by region.
desc.earthquake: Earthquake exposure index (Global Earthquake Model, 2023), by district.
desc.environmentalDegradation: Tree-cover loss, % (Global Forest Watch, 2000–2022), by district, and soil erosion (JRC), by region.
desc.flood: Flood exposure: % of people in modelled flood-prone areas (JRC global flood maps), by district.
desc.heatwave: No indicator with data in the workbook.
desc.lightning: No indicator with data in the workbook.
desc.stormsCyclone: Cyclone exposure at maximum wind speed, % (4TU.ResearchData, 2023), by district.
desc.wildfire: Burned area, % (JRC GWIS, 2019–2023) and fire weather index (GFDRR, 2022), by region.
desc.zoonoses: No indicator with data in the workbook.
desc.conflictIntensity: Conflict Barometer index (Heidelberg Institute for International Conflict Research, 2022), by region.
desc.conflictRisk: GCRI-derived conflict probability, % (JRC, 2024): one value for Tanzania.
desc.hazardousMaterial: No indicator with data in the workbook.
desc.internalViolence: Number of violent events and of fatalities (ACLED, 2020–2024), by region.
desc.vehicleAccidents: No indicator with data in the workbook.
desc.developmentPoverty: Human Development Index, Gender Development Index and wealth inequality (Global Data Lab, 2011–2022) and Multidimensional Poverty Index (OPHI, 2012–2021), by region.
desc.economicDependency: Net ODA received and personal remittances, % (World Bank, 2018–2023, national) and dependency ratio (Global Data Lab, 2011–2022), by region.
desc.habitat: Population in informal settlements, % (UN-Habitat, 2022, national) and urban population, % (Global Data Lab, 2013–2022), by region.
desc.livelihoods: Insufficient food: % of people in IPC phase 2 or higher (IPC, 2022–2024), by region.
desc.displacedPeople: Internally displaced people, number (IDMC, 2023), by region.
desc.healthConditions: Life expectancy (Global Data Lab, 2022) and malaria prevalence (Malaria Atlas Project, 2022), by region; measles incidence (WHO, 2019–2023), national.
desc.childrenHealthNutrition: Neonatal, infant and child mortality per 1,000 live births and children underweight, % (Global Data Lab, 2000–2022), by region.
desc.economic: No indicator with data in the workbook.
desc.accessHealth: BCG, DTP3 and measles immunisation coverage (Global Data Lab, 2006–2021) and density of health facilities (HDX, 2019), by region; health expenditure per capita and physicians density (WHO, 2017–2021), national.
desc.economicCapacity: International Wealth Index and GNI per capita (Global Data Lab, 2013–2022), by region; household income (World Bank, 2017–2021), national.
desc.wash: People using at least basic drinking water and basic sanitation services, % (WHO/UNICEF JMP, 2022): one value for Tanzania.
desc.communication: Access to electricity, cellphone ownership and internet access, % (Global Data Lab, 2011–2022), by region; internet access has no data.
desc.education: Mean years at school (Global Data Lab, 2022), by region; adult literacy rate (World Bank, 2020–2022), national.
desc.drrImplementation: Sendai Framework for Action index (UNDRR, 2017–2022) and people covered by early warning (Anticipation Hub, 2023): one value for Tanzania.
desc.governance: Subnational Corruption Index (Global Data Lab, 2022), by region; government effectiveness (World Bank, 2018–2022), national.
